#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<vector<long long>> a(n + 2, vector<long long>(n + 2, 0));
    vector<vector<long long>> b(n + 2, vector<long long>(n + 2, 0));

    for (int sum = 2 * n; sum >= 0; sum--) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            int j = sum - i;
            if (j < 0 || j > i) continue;
            if (i == n && j == n) continue;

            if (i == j) {
                a[i][j] = max(1 + b[i + 1][j], a[i + 1][j]);
                b[i][j] = a[i + 1][j];
            } else if (i == n) {
                a[i][j] = max(1 + b[i][j + 1], a[i][j + 1]);
                b[i][j] = a[i][j + 1];
            } else {
                long long downA = a[i + 1][j];
                long long rightA = a[i][j + 1];
                long long downB = b[i + 1][j];
                long long rightB = b[i][j + 1];
                long long v1 = (downA + rightA) % MOD;
                long long v2 = (1 + downB + rightA) % MOD;
                long long v3 = (1 + downA + rightB) % MOD;
                a[i][j] = max(v1, max(v2, v3));
                b[i][j] = v1;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << a[0][0] % MOD << endl;

    return 0;
}
